title: Local force moment interface for projected D-delta-D locality
question: Can the exact Q3 boundary force be localized to the two endpoint shifted onsite energies, yielding a conditional volume-uniform L4 coefficient bound under a uniform local third-moment hypothesis?
method: Use the sitewise shifted onsite energy from EXP-001057 and the exact Q3 force coefficient from EXP-001058.
Derive q^4 <= (8/g)e(q) and the pair endpoint-energy fourth-power force bound, then take the fourth root under an explicitly stated local third-moment hypothesis.
Recompute all rational constants independently on the registered 6x6 field grid and compile Lean R241 for the shift, ratio, prefactor and conditional-power fixtures.
finding: The Q3 boundary force admits the local endpoint bound |partial_q B|^4 <= C^4*max(1,8/g)^3*(1+e(q)+e(v))^3, with C=122099/35840 and e(q)=r*q^2/2+g*q^4/4+r^2/(2*g). Therefore a uniform local third-moment input M_beta,local yields the conditional L4 estimate C*max(1,8/g)^(3/4)*M_beta,local^(1/4), and the second generator coefficient adds |a|/(hbar*chi). Primary and independent lanes pass 123/123 and 191/191; the integrated verifier passes 23/23 with Lean R241.
decision_reason: This localizes the force estimate so that the next Duhamel bound need not pay the extensive global spectator shift. The required uniform local third-moment theorem is kept as a named conditional gate rather than silently inferred from finite-volume coercivity.
boundary: T0 claim-nonbearing conditional local-force moment bridge. The local moment hypothesis, all-time projected D and delta-D Cauchy, product/core density, exhaustion independence, group law, Hamiltonian-to-OS identification, common alpha, KMS/GNS, continuum, C6, Sector A and Pre-A remain open.

adversarial_review.check: The endpoint energy comparison is sitewise and does not use an extensive global shift as a local theorem.
Uniform local third moment is explicit conditional input and remains unproved.
The local prefactor is derived from C and max(1,8/g).
The fourth-power inequality gives the one-quarter moment exponent and three-quarter weight exponent.
The estimate applies to the second generator coefficient, not the full evolved difference.
R241 checks exact rational fixtures only.
D,delta-D, OS/KMS, GNS gap, continuum, C6, Sector A and Pre-A remain open.
No heat_root_incidence or A1/R-192 production owner is supplied.
